eventDescription:
The Valakkottai Arulmigu Subramania Swamy Temple successfully conducted the completion ceremony of the initiative to plant 2,000 trees at the Pasumaikaadu Nandavanam. A felicitation ceremony was also held to honour the students who contributed to this green initiative, with appreciation certificates presented to them.The event was held under the leadership of Mr. So. Senthilkumar, Executive Officer of Valakkottai Temple.
Hon?ble Minister for Welfare of Non-Resident Tamils, Mr. Thennarasu, participated as the Chief Guest. He planted saplings, presented appreciation certificates to the students who contributed to the environmental initiative, and delivered his felicitations.More than 400 students from Triveni Academy School, Agathiyar Matriculation Higher Secondary School, Rasi College, SRM University, APJ College, Aadhi College, and Sairam College actively participated in the event. Volunteers and members of the Vidhaigal volunteer organization also took part enthusiastically and contributed to the success of the programme.
